I think it's more interested in us than hungry.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="RPG" />}}
'''Receptive Telepathy''' was a [[Force power/Legends#Sense|Sense]]-base [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] which allowed [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]] to actively read a person's thoughts and feel their emotions. In some cases, the Force user could search a target's memories for specific information. It was easier to use on individuals who were close to the Force user emotionally, and some individuals, such as other Force users, could actively resist the technique. The power could be used against creatures as well, although using it against individuals of a different [[Species/Legends|species]] sometimes resulted in a difficulty to interpret information if the species processed emotions differently.<ref name="RPG" />
